**Describe the measurement**

A clear and concise description of what needs to be measured or analyzed and why.

**Measurement category**

Select the relevant measurement areas:

- [ ] Energy consumption
- [ ] Execution time / Performance
- [ ] CPU usage
- [ ] Memory usage
- [ ] Disk I/O
- [ ] Network usage
- [ ] Other

**Measurement methodology**

Describe how the measurements will be performed, including the tools, techniques, and testing conditions.

**Metrics to evaluate**

Specify the metrics that will be collected and analyzed (e.g., execution time, energy consumption in joules, CPU utilization, or memory consumption).

**Expected results**

Describe the expected outcomes or the objectives of the analysis.

**Comparison (if applicable)**

Specify whether the measurements will be compared against a baseline, previous implementation, or alternative solution.

**Additional context**

Add any relevant information, experimental data, graphs, logs, references, or screenshots related to the measurement.
